aviso: Synthetic test call: AI voices reading a role-play script. The store, Maya, Jordan and Sam are invented for testing.
guion:
Cris: Hi Maya, thanks for making time. Before I show anything, how do customer questions reach you today?
Maya: Mostly email and Instagram DMs. It's me and one part-time person, Jordan. Honestly, half my mornings go to "where is my order".
Cris: Half your mornings. Roughly how many messages a day is that?
Maya: Around forty on a normal day, way more after a launch.
Cris: And which questions come up the most?
Maya: Shipping times, whether the candles are safe around pets, and returns when a jar arrives cracked.
Cris: Got it. If those three got answered automatically, with the hard ones still coming to you, what would that be worth?
Maya: If it gave me my mornings back, I could see spending three to five hundred a month. More than that, I'd need to see it working first.
Cris: Fair. Who else would be part of the decision?
Maya: Just me. My business partner, Sam, signs off on anything over five hundred.
Cris: Understood. And timing?
Maya: Before Black Friday. So ideally set up by mid November.
Cris: Okay. Here's what I suggest: I'll send you a short proposal by Friday, and we book thirty minutes next Tuesday to walk through it with Sam.
Maya: Tuesday works. Send it over.
